candidates.description: 🛡️ Advanced multi-language security framework (C, Python, Go, TS) for repository hardening, automated auditing, and AI Agent self-improvement orchestration. Featuring the Future AGI platform.

This repository is a personal lab to experiment with the Microsoft Agent Framework and Azure AI Foundry. It includes a minimal Python setup, sample agents, orchestration patterns, and Azure integrations to prototype intelligent multi-agent systems and explore new ideas.
